description: Most structs in lib.rs derive #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] — e.g. Address at :589, Nickname at :169, EmailAddress at :352. Three deviate: Name at :90 derives PartialEq only, AnniversaryDate at :957 derives PartialEq only, Anniversary at :1001 derives PartialEq only. All three are Eq-eligible: serde_json::Value derives Eq, serde_json::Map<String, Value> derives Eq, NameComponent derives Eq, PartialDate derives Eq, Timestamp derives Eq, Address derives Eq. The omission looks like an oversight rather than a deliberate choice (no comment, no PLAN.md note, no precedent in the sibling jscalendar-types — which uniformly derives Eq on its analogous types). Suggested rewrite: add Eq to all three derive lists. If there is a hidden reason (intent to permit a future f64 field?), document it.
title: Name, AnniversaryDate, and Anniversary miss Eq derive while sibling Address has it
